title: The Truck That Came Home Light
synopsis: With the garage, park, and farm deliveries complete, the friends build a toy route from empty cartons and watch Dan return his lighter box truck to its shed.
continuity_state: Before: Dan has delivered four cones to Red Door Garage, a rain gauge to Pine Park, balanced hen feed to Green Gate Farm, and a green wheelbarrow to the farm. Dan's blue truck and parcel shed are established, and Jack has drawn the equipment across the season. After: All listed deliveries are complete. Dan returns the largely empty blue box truck to its covered parcel shed by the west junction. Jack adds a simple road-and-footpath route diagram to his blue notebook. Rex keeps one clean empty delivery carton folded flat behind the rug for future games. The garage cones, park rain gauge, and farm supplies remain in their established locations.
